newsitem.title: USA: BOWLIN Outdoor rises on first day of trade.
newsitem.headline: BOWLIN Outdoor rises on first day of trade.

text.p: Shares in BOWLIN Outdoor Advertising & Travel Centers Inc closed up 1/8 to 8-1/8 on their first day of trading.
The initial public offering of 1.1 million shares of common stock was underwritten by HD Brous & Co Inc.

BOWLIN Outdoor Advertising & Travel Centers, which operates travel centers and outdoor advertising displays, said that if the over-allotment option is exercised in full, 165,000 additional shares will be sold by the company.
